about: The Workbench icons of the Freeciv drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py platforms/amigaos3/icons/icons.json --out platforms/amigaos3/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is Freeciv's own client icon (data/icons/128x128/freeciv-client.png, GPL-2.0-or-later). The game's icon is the SDL2 client's own (packed as Freeciv), with the 1,000,000-byte stack it needs.
